name: MusicCaps
description: Approximately 5,500 music-and-text pairs used to evaluate MusicLM. The music is YouTube-derived; no data is vendored here, and source-media licensing and rights remain a risk that should be reviewed before use or redistribution.
citation: Agostinelli, A. et al. (2023). MusicCaps: A Dataset for Music Captioning. https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.11325

license.identifier: YouTube-derived terms (not a single SPDX identifier)
